{"kind":"reasoning","id":"p1-0c1737c8","text":"The user gives feedback:

1. First image: "Chapters across campuses nationwide" — write-up text is faint (the "0 activated chapters currently listed on this platform, each recorded with its own chapter code." text very faint). Also interesting: that whole section looks semi-transparent/gray because the image shows a section with low contrast — the section text "0 activated chapters..." is too faint. Make more clean/readable. So bump text opacities: my `text-white/75`, `rgba(238,244,252,0.78)` for text-navy-900/ etc. — those came out faint. Increase contrast: canvas text from rgba(...,.78) → .92; text-white/75 in intro → bump via CSS override? Easier: adjust the inversion values and specific intro classes in page-header (text-white/75 → /85). Also chapters-teaser has faint text using tokens.

2. Footer: "TOO MUCH AND A LOT" — simplify the footer. It's too busy: remove the giant cropped wordmark? They said the footer is bad and too much. Design a calmer, cleaner footer: keep logo + statement? Reduce: simpler columns, less hairline rows maybe. Make it cleaner: brand + 3 columns + connect + bottom bar; remove giant GLANCE wordmark, remove the "Young People. Real Solutions. A Stronger Nation." big statement + tagline + Become a member clutter. Keep it compact.

3. Logo: on dark header, GlanceLogo variant light = white plate — but the screenshot shows the plate is dark navy-blue and logo barely visible ("color of the logo too blue and didn't show well"). Wait — in image 1 header the logo shows on dark blue plate. The light variant renders a white plate; but the screenshot shows... the plate looks dark. Hmm — because `.site-canvas .bg-white` override turned the logo plate bg-white → dark navy panel! That's the bug: the logo plate uses bg-white class, my inversion darkened it, making the white plate dark blue, so the navy lockup is invisible. Fix: exclude logo plate from inversion by adding explicit arbitrary bg class (bg-[#ffffff]) or override in canvas: give GlanceLogo light variant a non-token class. Simplest: change glance-logo.tsx light variant to use `bg-[#ffffff]`. Also the footer logo + drawer logo same fix.

4. Scroll interactions: they want elements to fade/slide in on scroll (reveal/disappear-appear interactions). There's already a reveal.tsx component in the codebase! Check how it's used; wire Reveal into key sections. That was a file: src/components/site/reveal.tsx (90 lines). Maybe it's used in some home components already. If Reveal exists with IntersectionObserver, integrate into homepage sections + others. That's larger. Given "as you scroll up and down there should be a great interaction", implement a global reveal system: small client component that adds reveal classes to sections via a wrapper used in layout for each page? We can add a <Reveal> inside key components — but touching every component is big. Alternative: a SiteScrollReveal client component mounted in (site) layout that observes `main section, footer` elements and toggles `.in-view`. CSS: `[data-reveal] { opacity:0; translate: 0 24px; transition:... } [data-reveal].in-view { opacity:1; translate:0 }`. Apply data-reveal to sections automatically via JS (querySelectorAll on sections within main). That gives sitewide scroll-triggered fade/slide with minimal code and no hydration issues except it's client-only — progressive enhancement with fallback if JS is delayed? Content hidden until observer runs → risk: if JS fails, content invisible. Guard: add class only via JS (script runs, then observe). Use MutationObserver? Keep simple: in the client component, on mount, select `main > *` (sections), set attribute data-reveal for those not already in viewport, then IO adds .in-view. Fallback: if component errors, nothing hidden (attributes set by JS only → safe).

5. Zip intro should finish fully BEFORE homepage shows (currently shows homepage behind while zip is opening). site-intro.tsx: the intro renders fixed overlay with animation 8s, page visible underneath (they say "show the home then zip; but zip before the home"). Fix: make the site canvas hidden until zip completes — e.g., intro overlay opaque until it divides? The zip design inherently splits to reveal the page. The complaint: homepage is visible before/behind. Make the overlay background #03122a opaque (no split until near end?) They want: zip opens and only THEN homepage appears. Implement: site-canvas gets `hidden` (opacity 0 / visibility hidden) until intro signals done — via body class toggled by site-intro component on animation end, plus session-based skip (intro shows once per session?). Currently after 8s animation the overlay unmounts. If page hidden until end, first visit has 8s wait then reveal — they explicitly want that. Implementation: in (site) layout main div add class `intro-wait` when first visit; site-intro sets `document.documentElement.dataset.introDone` / adds class `.intro-done` to canvas → CSS: `.site-canvas:not(.intro-done)`... need coordination: simplest CSS-only approach: canvas opacity 0 + animation matching zip timing that delays reveal until zip parts? They want zip fully visible first, THEN homepage appears — i.e., page fades in after zip done. Use CSS animation delay: `.site-canvas.intro-wait { animation: canvas-reveal 600ms ease 7.6s both; }` wait 7.6s ≈ zip end (8s total). Both intro and page in same document with synchronized timeline: zip anim is 8s both; canvas reveal at 7.4s. If session already seen intro (component unmounts immediately), class not applied (component computes "showIntro" state; needs to be in sync with site-intro logic).

Read site-intro.tsx to mirror its session logic. Also .tmp reset. Let me read these files: reveal.tsx, site-intro.tsx, chapters-teaser.tsx (the faint section), and glance-logo.tsx again (already read). Check where "0 activated chapters currently listed..." copy is: chapters-teaser.tsx.

Plan edits:
1. glance-logo.tsx: light variant plate bg-[#ffffff] (immune to inversion). Also footer uses variant light. ✓
2. Contrast pass: canvas text overrides: /78 → /90; also add overrides for text-white/75 & /85 contexts? text-white/75 used in page-header intro & updates; on dark canvas it's okay but "faint" per user; bump via CSS override for text-white/75 within canvas → rgba(255,255,255,.88)? but some uses might be on white-ish backgrounds... on canvas everything's dark. Fine: override text-white/70 & /75 & /85 → near-white-ish .88/.92? Careful: consent pill? text-white/65 etc in header strip. OK bump only /75 (intro copy) to .88.
   Also `.site-canvas .text-navy-100` classes (footer description /75 /85) leave.
   And portal? not scoped — fine.
3. Footer simplify: rewrite site-footer compact: gold CTA band (keep, it's good) + single-row footer: logo block (short line), 3 columns simplified (no hairline ledger rows → simple lists), connect, bottom bar. Remove: big statement block, tagline flourish, giant cropped wordmark, ledger numerals. Keep it elegant but calm.
4. Scroll reveal: check reveal.tsx; create/adjust a global scroll reveal client component in site layout observing main>*, with CSS in globals.
5. Zip-before-home: mirror site-intro session logic; add intro-wait class + CSS animation delay.

{"kind":"reasoning","id":"p3-0c1737c8","text":"The user writes in English; my visible reasoning continues in English.

Now I have the full picture of SiteIntro: it plays once per browser (localStorage "glance:intro-seen"), `?intro=1` forces replay. The intro runs an 8s animation. During the animation, the page behind IS visible (that's the user's complaint: "show the home then zip; but zip before the home"). They want: zipper plays fully, THEN the homepage appears.

Implementation plan:

1. **Logo plate fix**: In `glance-logo.tsx`, the light variant plate uses `bg-white` — my `.site-canvas .bg-white` override darkened it, making the navy lockup invisible on the dark plate. Fix: use `bg-[#ffffff]` so it's immune to the token inversion. This affects header, footer, drawer, intro.

2. **Contrast fix (faint text)**: In chapters-teaser, the intro text "0 activated chapters currently listed…" comes from SectionHeading with `text-ink-500` → my override made it `#9fb1ca` on `bg-navy-50/50` (flipped to translucent white over dark canvas). In the screenshot the whole section looks washed. Bump the inversion values: make `.text-ink-500/600/700` → lighter `#b6c5db`, `.text-ink-400` → `#93a5bf`, `/78` navy → `.9`. Also bump `text-white/75` in canvas to 0.88 via CSS override? text-white/75 is Nav-tailwind generated exact class `text-white/75`... override `.site-canvas .text-white\/75`. Also `text-white/70` shouldn't be raised everywhere (used on dark chips already fine)... but raising slightly is harmless. I'll target /75 only (page intro copy), plus intro rgba values.

But careful: the EmptyState description text ("Once GLANCE activates a chapter...") also uses text-ink-500 — bumping ink helps that too.

Also the screenshot shows the whole teaser section has a light-gray background overlay — that's `bg-navy-50/50` (class `bg-navy-50/50`, which I didn't enumerate! I only did /40 /60 /70). `bg-navy-50/50` → color-mix of navy-50 (light #eff5fd) at 50% with transparent → semi-light gray over dark canvas → looks washed/gray, killing contrast. Fix: add `.bg-navy-50\/50` to the flip list (and generally any `bg-navy-50/xx`). Better: replace my enumerated slash overrides with an attribute-based selector `[class*="bg-navy-50/"]` BUT that also matches hover variants (hover:bg-navy-50/80 in nav, hover:bg-navy-50/40 dir rows) — those are literal class names in attr; the element with `hover:bg-navy-50/80` would get the translucent panel bg applied always (attribute matches substring in the class attribute, ignoring Tailwind's generated `:hover` semantics!) — because `.site-canvas [class*="bg-navy-50/"] { background-color: ... }` applies unconditionally to that element. Nav links hover-bg would be always-on → bad.

Safer: enumerate exact escaped classes. Which variants exist in (site)? From the search: bg-navy-50/60 (Section tint, verify), /40 (EmptyState, start-a-chapter, dir hover rows?), /70 (DataTable head), /50 (chapters-teaser, gallery?), hover:bg-navy-50/40 (dir rows), hover:bg-navy-50/80 (nav). Add .bg-navy-50\/50. Keep hover ones alone (they're color-mix with token → result is light-navy tint over dark = acceptable hover).

Wait, also dir rows hover:bg-navy-50/40: hover state uses token color-mix — navy-50 40% opacity over canvas = light tint — fine as hover highlight.

But hold on — those bg-navy-50/* RAMP: Tailwind v4 arbitrary opacity `bg-navy-50/50` generates `color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-navy-50) 50%, transparent)` — light color at 50% over dark → washed. Flipping exact classes to `rgba(255,255,255,0.045)` — but hover:bg-navy-50/40 stays light-tint — a bit bright for hover rows; acceptable.

3. **Footer simplify**: Rewrite site-footer.tsx to a calmer, cleaner design:
   - Keep gold CTA band (they haven't complained about the band specifically; "footer is bad, too much and a lot"). Simplify below-band: one compact dark section: logo (light plate) + one-line description left; three simple link columns center; connect right; slim bottom bar. Remove: big headline statement block, mono tagline flourishes, index numerals, hairline ledger rows, giant cropped wordmark, "Become a member" extra CTA. Also remove the tw gradient seams. Simple, clean.

4. **Scroll reveal sitewide**: The Reveal component exists but is used only in some home components. The user wants scroll interactions everywhere ("disappear and appear design as you scroll"). Global approach: new client component `SiteScrollMotion` mounted in (site) layout: on mount, `document.querySelectorAll('main section > *, footer > *')`? Simpler: observe direct children of `main > *` — sections. Parent sections get `data-scroll-reveal` + IO adds `.revealed`. CSS in globals under canvas scope:
```
.site-canvas [data-scroll-reveal] { opacity: 0; translate: 0 28px; transition: opacity .7s ease, translate .7s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); will-change: opacity,translate }
.site-canvas [data-scroll-reveal].revealed { opacity:1; translate:0 }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { disable }
```
Attribute set by JS only → no-JS users unaffected. Also for reveal to not jank on already-in-viewport sections (hero): if entry.isIntersecting initially → add .revealed immediately (IO fires initially for intersecting elements anyway).

Also add subtle "scroll-up re-hide"? They said "disappear and appear as you scroll up and down" — could re-hide when out of view (toggle both directions). IO with threshold: set .revealed when intersecting, remove when leaving (rootMargin -12%). That gives the appear/disappear feel. But re-hiding sections while scrolling down past them... it toggles when they leave viewport bottom — fine.

Implement `SiteScrollMotion` in `src/components/site/scroll-motion.tsx`, include in layout inside canvas.

5. **Zip before home**: Make the canvas hidden until the zipper finishes on first visit. Mirror the intro gating: in layout I can't know localStorage (server). Do it in SiteScrollMotion (client, runs before paint? No—after hydration, too late; user would see page flash then hide). Better: an inline blocking script in `<head>` that sets a class on documentElement synchronously before render: `if (localStorage['glance:intro-seen'] !== '1' && !?intro skip) html.classList.add('intro-waiting')`. The layout's root html — app/layout.tsx renders <html>. Add an inline script via Next `<script dangerouslySetInnerHTML>` in app/layout head/body start. Then CSS:
```
.intro-waiting .site-canvas .site-content? 
```
Simplest: hide the whole `main` + header/footer? The zip overlay (site-intro) covers everything visually anyway; the complaint is that the page shows *behind/through* the split zip as it opens (page revealed simultaneously with zip). They want zip plays on solid fabric, completes, then content appears.

Implementation: canvas content (header/main/footer) wrapped with a class `.site-stage`; when html has .intro-waiting, .site-stage is visibility:hidden + opacity 0; when intro completes, site-intro's timeout removes html class (or site-intro client detects completion). Coordination: SiteIntro already computes seenBefore/remaining. I'll have SiteIntro set `document.documentElement.classList.add('intro-waiting')` when it will play, and remove it when unmounting/completing. Then CSS:
```
.intro-waiting .site-stage { visibility: hidden; }
.site-stage { visibility: visible; }
```
Server-render guards: on SSR, no class → content visible in HTML; only visible-flash issue before hydration... The inline script approach avoids flash: add tiny blocking script early in body of app layout that reads localStorage and adds .intro-waiting synchronously before paint. Then SiteIntro is authoritative too? Two mechanisms might conflict: if localStorage says seen → no class; SiteIntro then also doesn't play. Aligned. If unseen → class set; SiteIntro plays and removes class after animation. Forced via ?intro=1: localStorage set to '1' during effect! The inline script runs BEFORE effect — but on forced replay localStorage already '1' → inline script won't add class, yet intro plays — page visible during forced replay: current behavior, fine (replay is developer-forced; user asked default first-visit behavior). Hmm, but careful — user may test with ?intro=1. Support forced: inline script can check `location.search.includes('intro')` → treat as waiting too: `const forced = new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('intro') && !location.search.includes('hold')`... simpler: if (seen!=='1' || location.search.includes('intro')) add class. But ?intro=hold: SiteIntro holds frozen; class remains for 10min — body overflow hidden + stage hidden — that's review mode, acceptable? They'd see nothing behind... hold is for reviewing the closed zip alone. OK acceptable; keep simple.

Also reduced-motion: SiteIntro plays 0s instantly → removes class in effect after remaining=0 → immediate.

Also on unmount timer, effect cleanup runs removes data-intro-hold... I'll remove the class in the timer and in the "seenBefore" early-return path (not needed there since script only adds when unseen).

Edge: effect ordering — SiteIntro effect runs on mount; page first paint: stage hidden → zip animates (8s) → timer unmounts intro AND removes class → stage visible. During removal, add a short fade: transition opacity 400ms on .site-stage (transition won't animate from visibility hidden; use opacity: hidden via opacity 0 + pointer-events none; then remove → fades in). `.intro-waiting .site-stage { opacity:0; pointer-events:none; }` with `.site-stage { transition: opacity 500ms ease; }` — initial paint with class → opacity 0; class removed → transitions to 1.

But wait — inline script in app/layout: App Router — can use `<script dangerouslySetInnerHTML>` as first child of <body> in app/layout.tsx. Need to read app/layout.tsx and edit. It has fonts/GlanceLogo? Read it.

Also the header is sticky inside stage wrapper; wrapping header+main+footer in a div .site-stage inside .site-canvas — edit layout.tsx again.

6. Also zip intro itself: canvas visible behind during hold? n/a.

Let me also fix `hero-wash` etc — hero on home may still use `.hero-wash` (light!) — home hero uses hero-wash light gradient → on dark canvas a huge light wash — screenshot 1 top shows a normalish hero. Image 1 shows gray-washed section — that's the teaser. The screenshot 1 hero (top, cut off) looks dark w/ a card. OK.

Also "first image: write-up faint" — that's the SectionHeading intro & EmptyState in teaser; fixed by contrast bumps + bg-navy-50/50 flip.

Also uppercase tracking heading "EXPLORE" fine.

Now execute:
1. Write new site-footer.tsx (compact clean).
2. glance-logo.tsx: bg-[#ffffff].
3. globals.css: contrast bumps (ink texts, /78→.9, add bg-navy-50/50 flip, text-white/75 bump), stage CSS + scroll-reveal CSS.
4. layout(site): wrap stage + include scroll-motion client component.
5. scroll-motion component.
6. site-intro effect: add/remove intro-waiting class.
7. app/layout.tsx: inline pre-paint script.
8. tsc + visual checks.

{"kind":"tool","id":"eKQ_W9M3YIA","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"src\components\site\site-footer.tsx","instructions":"Replace the footer with a compact, calm design: gold CTA band, one tidy link block, slim legal bar; no giant wordmark or ledger ornament","content":"import Link from "next/link";
import { CopyrightYear } from "@/components/site/copyright-year";
import { GlanceLogo } from "@/components/glance-logo";
import { MailIcon } from "@/components/icons";
import { brand } from "@/lib/glance";
import { footerColumns, socialLinks } from "@/lib/nav";

/**
 * A calm, compact footer: the gold conversion band, then one quiet dark
 * block — brand left, three link columns, connect right — and a slim legal
 * bar. No ornament: the space does the talking.
 */
export function SiteFooter() {
  return (
    <footer className="mt-auto">
      {/* CTA band: one clear conversion before the directory. */}
      <div className="gold-band w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-gold-400 to-gold-500">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1280px] flex-col items-start justify-between gap-6 px-5 py-10 sm:px-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:px-8">
          <div className="max-w-[520px]">
            <h2 className="text-[clamp(22px,3vw,30px)] leading-[1.12] font-extrabold tracking-[-0.02em] text-navy-950">
              Ready to lead the change on your campus?
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-2.5 text-[14.5px] leading-relaxed text-navy-950/75">
              Join a movement of young people building a stronger nation.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
            <Link
              href="/join"
              className="inline-flex h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-navy-950 px-6 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-[#0e3163]"
            >
              Join GLANCE
            </Link>
            <Link
              href="/start-a-chapter"
              className="inline-flex h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-navy-950/30 px-6 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-navy-950 transition-colors hover:bg-navy-950/10"
            >
              Start a Chapter
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="navy-wash-footer w-full text-white">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1280px] flex-col gap-10 px-5 py-12 sm:px-6 lg:flex-row lg:gap-14 lg:px-8">
          {/* Brand */}
          <div className="max-w-[300px] shrink-0">
            <GlanceLogo variant="light" />
            <p className="mt-5 text-[13px] leading-[1.8] text-white/60">
              {brand.expansion} — a structured leadership and civic engagement
              club across tertiary institutions.
            </p>
            <a
              href={`mailto:${brand.contactEmail}`}
              className="mt-5 inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-gold-400 transition-colors hover:text-gold-300"
            >
              <MailIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
              {brand.contactEmail}
            </a>
          </div>

          {/* Link columns */}
          <div className="grid flex-1 grid-cols-2 gap-10 sm:grid-cols-3">
            {footerColumns.map((column) => (
              <nav key={column.heading} aria-label={column.heading}>
                <h3 className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.18em] text-white/55 uppercase">
                  {column.heading}
                </h3>
                <ul className="mt-4 space-y-2.5 text-[13.5px] text-white/80">
                  {column.links.map((link) => (
                    <li key={link.label}>
                      <Link
                        href={link.href}
                        className="transition-colors hover:text-gold-400"
                      >
                        {link.label}
                      </Link>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </nav>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Legal bar */}
        <div className="border-t border-white/10">
          <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-[1280px] flex-col gap-3 px-5 py-5 text-[12.5px] text-white/55 sm:px-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between lg:px-8">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
              <Link href="/privacy" className="transition-colors hover:text-white">
                Privacy Policy
              </Link>
              <span className="h-3 w-px bg-white/20" aria-hidden="true" />
              <Link href="/terms" className="transition-colors hover:text-white">
                Terms of Use
              </Link>
              <span className="h-3 w-px bg-white/20" aria-hidden="true" />
              {socialLinks.map((social, index) => (
                <span key={social.label} className="inline-flex items-center gap-3">
                  {index > 0 ? (
                    <span className="h-3 w-px bg-white/20" aria-hidden="true" />
                  ) : null}
                  <a
                    href={social.href}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="transition-colors hover:text-white"
                  >
                    {social.label}
                  </a>
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
            <p>
              © <CopyrightYear /> GLANCE. All rights reserved.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>
  );
}
"}}

import { useEffect } from "react";

/**
 * Sitewide scroll motion, without touching every component: on mount this
 * observes each top-level block of the page body and toggles `revealed` as
 * blocks enter and leave the viewport, so content fades/slides in going down
 * and recedes going up. The attribute is only set from JavaScript, so if
 * this never runs the page renders fully visible — no content lock-out.
 * Respects prefers-reduced-motion by doing nothing at all.
 */
export function SiteScrollMotion() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
      return;
    }
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;

    const stages = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".site-canvas main > *"),
    );
    if (stages.length === 0) return;

    for (const stage of stages) {
      stage.setAttribute("data-scroll-reveal", "");
    }

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add("revealed");
          } else if (entry.boundingClientRect.top > 0) {
            // Only recede when the block leaves through the bottom of the
            // viewport (i.e. the reader has scrolled past it downward).
            entry.target.classList.remove("revealed");
          }
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: "0px 0px -12% 0px", threshold: 0.06 },
    );

    for (const stage of stages) observer.observe(stage);
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      for (const stage of stages) {
        stage.removeAttribute("data-scroll-reveal");
        stage.classList.remove("revealed");
      }
    };
  }, []);

  return null;
}

+"use client";
+
+import { useEffect } from "react";
+
+/**
+ * Sitewide scroll motion, without touching every component: on mount this
+ * observes each top-level block of the page body and toggles `revealed` as
+ * blocks enter and leave the viewport, so content fades/slides in going down
+ * and recedes going up. The attribute is only set from JavaScript, so if
+ * this never runs the page renders fully visible — no content lock-out.
+ * Respects prefers-reduced-motion by doing nothing at all.
+ */
+export function SiteScrollMotion() {
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
+      return;
+    }
+    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return;
+
+    const stages = Array.from(
+      document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".site-canvas main > *"),
+    );
+    if (stages.length === 0) return;
+
+    for (const stage of stages) {
+      stage.setAttribute("data-scroll-reveal", "");
+    }
+
+    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
+      (entries) => {
+        for (const entry of entries) {
+          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
+            entry.target.classList.add("revealed");
+          } else if (entry.boundingClientRect.top > 0) {
+            // Only recede when the block leaves through the bottom of the
+            // viewport (i.e. the reader has scrolled past it downward).
+            entry.target.classList.remove("revealed");
+          }
+        }
+      },
+      { rootMargin: "0px 0px -12% 0px", threshold: 0.06 },
+    );
+
+    for (const stage of stages) observer.observe(stage);
+    return () => {
+      observer.disconnect();
+      for (const stage of stages) {
+        stage.removeAttribute("data-scroll-reveal");
+        stage.classList.remove("revealed");
+      }
+    };
+  }, []);
+
+  return null;
+}

/* ---- Page transitions ----------------------------------------------- */

/*
 * Calm cross-fade between pages, driven by PageTransition (page-transition.tsx).
 * The old page dims slightly as you follow an internal link; the new page
 * rises in with a short fade. Never fully blanks the screen, so navigation
 * can never leave the user on white.
 */

.page-leave {
  transition: opacity 220ms ease;
}

.page-leave--active {
  opacity: 0.72;
}

.page-enter {
  animation: page-enter-rise 460ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1) both;
}

@keyframes page-enter-rise {
  from {
    opacity: 0.35;
    translate: 0 14px;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    translate: 0 0;
  }
}

/* Hairline of gold across the top while the next page loads. */
.nav-progress {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 9998;
  height: 2px;
  width: 100%;
  transform: scaleX(0);

  background: linear-gradient(

    #ea ae14,
    rgba(234, 174, 20, 0.35)
  );
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 200ms ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.nav-progress--active {
  opacity: 1;
  animation: nav-progress-slide 900ms ease-out both;
}

@keyframes nav-progress-slide {
  from {
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }
  to {
    transform: scaleX(0.85);

}","allowMultiple":false}]}}

type SceneId = (typeof SCENES)[number]["id"];

function sceneAt(t: number): SceneId | null {
  for (const scene of SCENES) {
    if (t >= scene.from && t < scene.to) return scene.id;
  }
  return null;
}

function timecode(t: number): string {
  const total = Math.floor(t);
  const frames = Math.floor((t - total) * 25);
  const mm = String(Math.floor(total / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
  const ss = String(total % 60).padStart(2, "0");
  const ff = String(frames).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${mm}:${ss}:${ff}`;
}

/* ── Shared helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function useCountUp(target: number, duration = 4200) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    let raf = 0;
    const start = performance.now();
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const p = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration);
      setValue(Math.round(target * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3))));
      if (p < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [target, duration]);
  return value;
}

export function GlanceBroadcast({ stats }: { stats: BroadcastStats }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<"idle" | "playing" | "paused" | "done">("idle");
  const [t, setT] = useState(0);
  const rafRef = useRef(0);
  const startRef = useRef(0);

  const activeScene = state === "idle" || state === "done" ? null : sceneAt(t);

  const loop = useCallback(() => {
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    const next = (performance.now() - startRef.current) / 1000;
    if (next >= DURATION) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
      setT(DURATION);
      setState("done");
      return;
    }
    setT(next);
  }, []);

  const play = useCallback(() => {
    startRef.current = performance.now() - t * 1000;
    setState("playing");
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }, [loop, t]);

  const pause = useCallback(() => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    setState("paused");
  }, []);

  const restart = useCallback(() => {
    setT(0);
    startRef.current = performance.now();
    setState("playing");
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }, [loop]);

  useEffect(() => () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current), []);

  const overlay = state === "idle" || state === "done";

  return (
    <div className="glance-broadcast">
      <style>{CSS}</style>

      <div

          {activeScene === "work" ? <WorkScene /> : null}
          {activeScene === "numbers" ? <NumbersScene stats={stats} /> : null}
          {activeScene === "footprint" ? <FootprintScene stats={stats} /> : null}
          {activeScene === "outro" ? <OutroScene /> : null}
        </div>

        {/* Broadcast chrome */}
        {!overlay ? (
          <>
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute top-3 left-4 z-20 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-navy-950/70 py-1 pr-3 pl-2 backdrop-blur">
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="bc-blink h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500" />
              <span className="text-[9.5px] font-bold tracking-[0.22em] text-white/80 uppercase">
                GLANCE Broadcast
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute top-3 right-4 z-20 rounded-full bg-navy-950/70 px-3 py-1 backdrop-blur">
              <span className="bc-timecode font-data text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[0.14em] text-gold-300">{timecode(t)}</span>
            </div>

            {/* Click-to-pause surface */}
            <button
              type="button"
              className="absolute inset-0 z-10 cursor-pointer"

export type BroadcastStats = {

};

const DURATION = 40;

const SCENES = [
  { id: "signal", from: 0, to: 5.4 },
  { id: "manifesto", from: 5.4, to: 12.0 },
  { id: "nameplate", from: 12.0, to: 18.6 },
  { id: "work", from: 18.6, to: 26.4 },
  { id: "numbers", from: 26.4, to: 33.4 },
  { id: "footprint", from: 33.4, to: 38.6 },
  { id: "outro", from: 38.6, to: 40 },
] as const;

type SceneId = (typeof SCENES)[number]["id"];

function sceneAt(t: number): SceneId | null {
  for (const scene of SCENES) {
    if (t >= scene.from && t < scene.to) return scene.id;
  }
  return null;
}

function timecode(t: number): string {
  const total = Math.floor(t);
  const frames = Math.floor((t - total) * 25);
  const mm = String(Math.floor(total / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
  const ss = String(total % 60).padStart(2, "0");
  const ff = String(frames).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${mm}:${ss}:${ff}`;
}

/* ── Shared helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function useCountUp(target: number, duration = 4200) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    let raf = 0;
    const start = performance.now();
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const p = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration);
      setValue(Math.round(target * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3))));
      if (p < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [target, duration]);
  return value;
}

/* ── The player ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export function GlanceBroadcast({ stats }: { stats: BroadcastStats }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<"idle" | "playing" | "paused" | "done">("idle");
  const [t, setT] = useState(0);
  const rafRef = useRef(0);
  const startRef = useRef(0);

  const activeScene = state === "idle" || state === "done" ? null : sceneAt(t);

  const loop = useCallback(() => {
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    const next = (performance.now() - startRef.current) / 1000;
    if (next >= DURATION) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
      setT(DURATION);
      setState("done");
      return;
    }
    setT(next);
  }, []);

  const play = useCallback(() => {
    startRef.current = performance.now() - t * 1000;
    setState("playing");
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }, [loop, t]);

  const pause = useCallback(() => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    setState("paused");
  }, []);

  const restart = useCallback(() => {
    setT(0);
    startRef.current = performance.now();
    setState("playing");
    cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }, [loop]);

  useEffect(() => () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current), []);

  const overlay = state === "idle" || state === "done";

  return (
    <div className="glance-broadcast">
      <style>{CSS}</style>

      <div
        className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-navy-950 shadow-[0_50px_120px_-40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)]"
        role="img"
        aria-label="GLANCE broadcast: a 40-second motion story of the movement."
      >
        {/* Stage: the active scene */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0" key={activeScene ?? "none"}>
          {activeScene === "signal" ? <SignalScene /> : null}
          {activeScene === "manifesto" ? <ManifestoScene /> : null}
          {activeScene === "nameplate" ? <NameplateScene /> : null}
          {activeScene === "work" ? <WorkScene /> : null}
          {activeScene === "numbers" ? <NumbersScene stats={stats} /> : null}
          {activeScene === "footprint" ? <FootprintScene stats={stats} /> : null}
          {activeScene === "outro" ? <OutroScene /> : null}
        </div>

        {/* Broadcast chrome */}
        {!overlay ? (
          <>
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute top-3 left-4 z-20 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-navy-950/70 py-1 pr-3 pl-2 backdrop-blur">
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="bc-blink h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500" />
              <span className="text-[9.5px] font-bold tracking-[0.22em] text-white/80 uppercase">
                GLANCE Broadcast
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute top-3 right-4 z-20 rounded-full bg-navy-950/70 px-3 py-1 backdrop-blur">
              <span className="bc-timecode font-data text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-[0.14em] text-gold-300">
                {timecode(t)}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Click-to-pause surface */}
            <button
              type="button"
              className="absolute inset-0 z-10 cursor-pointer"
              aria-label={state === "paused" ? "Resume the GLANCE broadcast" : "Pause the GLANCE broadcast"}
              onClick={() => (state === "paused" ? play() : pause())}
            />

            {/* Progress rail */}
            <div className="absolute right-0 bottom-0 left-0 z-20 h-8 bg-gradient-to-t from-navy-950/85 to-transparent">
              <div className="absolute top-1/2 right-4 left-4 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/15">
                <span
                  className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 rounded-full bg-gold-400"
                  style={{ width: `${(t / DURATION) * 100}%` }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Pause badge */}
            {state === "paused" ? (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 z-[15] flex items-center justify-center bg-navy-950/55 backdrop-blur-[2px]">
                <span className="bc-pop rounded-full border border-white/25 bg-navy-950/80 px-6 py-3 text-[12px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-gold-300 uppercase">
                  Paused — tap to continue
                </span>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </>
        ) : (
          /* Poster / replay overlay */
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-30 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-5 bg-navy-950">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-40">
              <Image src={audienceClap} alt="" fill sizes="100vw" className="object-cover" />
            </div>
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(90%_90%_at_50%_40%,rgba(3,12,28,0.55),rgba(3,12,28,0.95))]" />
            <p className="bc-fade-up relative text-[10.5px] font-bold tracking-[0.3em] text-gold-400 uppercase">
              {state === "done" ? "Thanks for watching" : "GLANCE presents"}
            </p>
            <div className="bc-fade-up relative" style={{ animationDelay: "0.15s" }}>
              <p className="font-display text-[clamp(30px,5.4vw,58px)] leading-none font-extrabold tracking-[0.02em] text-white">
                The movement in <span className="text-gold-400">40 seconds</span>
              </p>
            </div>
            <p
              className="bc-fade-up relative max-w-[480px] px-6 text-center text-[clamp(11px,1.6vw,14.5px)] leading-relaxed text-white/70"
              style={{ animationDelay: "0.3s" }}
            >
              Chapters, mentorship and real civic work across Nigeria — cut like
              a showreel, told by the people in the room.
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => (state === "done" ? restart() : play())}
              className="sheen bc-fade-up group relative mt-2 inline-flex h-14 items-center gap-3 rounded-full bg-gold-400 px-8 text-[14px] font-bold text-navy-950 shadow-[0_18px_40px_-14px_rgba(251,202,75,0.55)] transition-transform hover:scale-[1.03]"
              style={{ animationDelay: "0.45s" }}
            >
              <span
                aria-hidden="true"
                className="grid h-7 w-7 place-items-center rounded-full bg-navy-950 text-gold-400 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"
              >
                <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" className="h-3 w-3 translate-x-[1px]" fill="currentColor">
                  <path d="M2 1.2v9.6L10.5 6z" />
                </svg>
              </span>
              {state === "done" ? "Watch again" : "Play the broadcast"}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[0.16em] text-white/45 uppercase">
        Rendered in motion · {DURATION} seconds · plays right here
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Scoped animation styles ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

const CSS = `
.glance-broadcast .bc-fade-up { opacity: 0; animation: bcFadeUp .8s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1) forwards; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-pop { opacity: 0; animation: bcPop .7s cubic-bezier(.3,1.5,.45,1) forwards; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-flicker { opacity: 0; animation: bcFlicker .5s steps(3, end) forwards; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-grow { transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; animation: bcGrow ease-out forwards; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-bar-in { opacity: 0; animation: bcBarIn .55s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1) forwards; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-wipe-pop { opacity: 0; animation: bcWipePop .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1) forwards; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-slide-left { opacity: 0; animation: bcSlideLeft .8s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1) forwards .5s; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-ping { animation: bcPing 2.4s ease-out infinite; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-blink { animation: bcBlink 1.1s steps(2, start) infinite; }

.glance-broadcast .bc-ken { animation: bcKen 11s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-ken-slow { animation: bcKen 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-drift { animation: bcDrift 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.glance-broadcast .bc-scan {
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 3px, rgba(255,255,255,.045) 3px 4px);
  animation: bcScan 4s linear infinite;
}
.glance-broadcast .bc-shine {
  background-size: 220% 100%;
  animation: bcShine 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes bcFadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(26px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes bcPop { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.72); } 60% { transform: scale(1.06); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
@keyframes bcFlicker { 0% { opacity: 0; } 20% { opacity: .55; } 35% { opacity: 0; } 55% { opacity: .8; } 70% { opacity: 0; } 100% { opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes bcGrow { to { transform: scaleX(1); } }
@keyframes bcBarIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-14%); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes bcWipePop { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px) scale(.96); clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } }
@keyframes bcSlideLeft { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(60px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes bcPing { 0%, 100% { opacity: .35; } 50% { opacity: .05; } }
@keyframes bcBlink { 0%, 49% { opacity: 1; } 50%, 100% { opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes bcKen { from { transform: scale(1.02); } to { transform: scale(1.14); } }
@keyframes bcDrift { from { transform: translate(0, 0); } to { transform: translate(-18px, 22px); } }

{"kind":"tool","id":"gPfCCfvty8M","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":".tmp/build-ng-meta.mjs","instructions":"Create a build script that generates a decimated client-safe Nigeria map module from ng-states.json.","content":"import fs from "node:fs";

const SOURCE = "src/components/portal/ng-states.json";
const OUT = "src/lib/ng-map-lite.ts";

const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(SOURCE, "utf8"));

function decimate(points, tolerance) {
  const px = [];
  let p0 = points[0];
  for (const p of points) {
    const dx = p[0] - p0[0];
    const dy = p[1] - p0[1];
    if (Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) >= tolerance) {
      px.push(p);
      p0 = p;
    }
  }
  if (px[px.length - 1] !== points[points.length - 1]) {
    px.push(points[points.length - 1]);
  }
  return px;
}

function pathToPoints(d) {
  // Highcharts-style path: "M x,yL x,yL x,y..." or space-separated.
  const tokens = d.replace(/(M|L)/g, " $1 ").trim().split(/\s+/);
  const points = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < tokens.length; i += 3) {
    const cmd = tokens[i];
    const x = parseFloat(tokens[i + 1]);
    const y = parseFloat(tokens[i + 2]);
    if (Number.isFinite(x) && Number.isFinite(y)) points.push([x, y]);
    else break;
  }
  return points;
}

function pointsToPath(points) {
  if (!points.length) return "";
  let d = `M${points[0][0].toFixed(1)},${points[0][1].toFixed(1)}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
    d += `L${points[i][0].toFixed(1)},${points[i][1].toFixed(1)}`;
  }
  return d + "Z";
}

const states = [];
let totalLen = 0;
for (const s of raw.states) {
  const pts = pathToPoints(s.d);
  const kept = decimate(pts, 4.5);
  const d = pointsToPath(kept);
  totalLen += d.length;
  states.push({ a: s.a, n: s.n, d });
}

const out = `/* eslint-disable */
// Auto-generated: client-safe Ital decimated Nigeria map geometry, real state
// outlines for cinematic use on the public site. Source of truth:
// src/components/portal/ng-states.json (Highcharts-style paths, 1000x813.5,
// y-axis INVERTED — mirror with scale(1,-1) translate(0,-813.5)).
//
// Regenerate with: node .tmp/build-ng-meta.mjs

export type NgLiteState = { a: string; n: string; d: string };

export const NG_LITE_BBOX: [number, number, number, number] = ${JSON.stringify(raw.bbox)};

export const NG_LITE_STATES: NgLiteState[] = ${JSON.stringify(states)};
`;

fs.writeFileSync(OUT, out);
console.log(`states: ${states.length}, total path chars: ${totalLen}`);
"}}

let anthemGain: GainNode | null = null;
let anthemTimer: number | null = null;
let anthemRunning = false;
let anthemNoteIdx = 0;

function anthemBell(f: number, at: number, dur: number) {
  const ctx = audioCtx!;
  const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
  const g = ctx.createGain();
  osc.type = "sine";
  osc.frequency.value = f;
  const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator(); // soft fifth above? maybe octave shimmer
  osc2.type = "sine";
  osc2.frequency.value = f * 2;
  const g2 = ctx.createGain(); g2.gain.value = 0.18;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, at);
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.30, at + 0.25);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.30, at + Math.max(0.25, dur - 0.35));
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, at + dur);
  osc.connect(g); osc2.connect(g2).connect(g);
  g.connect(anthemGain!);
  osc.start(at); osc2.start(at);
  osc.stop(at + dur + 0.05); osc2.stop(at + dur + 0.05);
}

function startAnthem() {
  const ctx = ensureAudioCtx();
  if (!ctx || !master || anthemRunning) return;
  anthemRunning = true;
  anthemGain ??= ctx.createGain();
  anthemGain.gain.value = 0.32;
  anthemGain.connect(master);
  const beat = 0.95; // Maestoso ≈ 63 bpm
  const step = () => {
    if (!anthemRunning || !audioCtx) return;
    const note = ANTHEM[anthemNoteIdx % ANTHEM.length];
    // hold a full breath of silence at the melody's seam
    const gap = anthemNoteIdx % ANTHEM.length === ANTHEM.length - 1 ? 2.2 : 0.15;
    const at = audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05;
    anthemBell(note.f, at, note.d * beat);
    anthemTimer = window.setTimeout(step, (note.d * beat + gap) * 1000 - 50);
    anthemNoteIdx++;
  };
  step();
}

function stopAnthem() {
  anthemRunning = false;
  if (anthemTimer !== null) window.clearTimeout(anthemTimer);
  anthemTimer = null;
  if (anthemGain && audioCtx) {
    const g = anthemGain;
    g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(audioCtx.currentTime);
    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.8);
    window.setTimeout(() => { try { g.disconnect(); } catch {} }, 900);
    anthemGain = null;
  }
}

/* The anthem bed: a gentle instrumental read of "Nigeria, we hail thee" —
   the restored 2024 national anthem — playing behind the narration, never
   over it. The melody is transposed note-for-note from published tonic-solfa
   transcriptions of the Ekwueme SATB score (Maestoso, quarter ≈ 63): G-C-G-E
   / E-F-G / G-C'-G / C-E-G. Everything stays inside the master bus, so a
   ducked passage quiets the anthem with the pad together. */
type AnthemNote = { f: number; d: number };
const ANTHEM_MELODY: AnthemNote[] = [
  { f: 196.0, d: 1.5 }, // Ni     (G3, dotted quarter)
  { f: 261.6, d: 0.5 }, // ge     (C4)
  { f: 196.0, d: 1.0 }, // ri     (G3)
  { f: 329.6, d: 2.0 }, // a      (E4, held)
  { f: 329.6, d: 1.0 }, // we     (E4)
  { f: 349.2, d: 1.0 }, // hail   (F4)
  { f: 392.0, d: 2.0 }, // thee   (G4, held)
  { f: 392.0, d: 1.5 }, // our    (G4)
  { f: 523.3, d: 0.5 }, // own    (C5)
  { f: 392.0, d: 1.0 }, // dear   (G4)
  { f: 261.6, d: 1.0 }, // na     (C4)
  { f: 329.6, d: 1.0 }, // tive   (E4)
  { f: 392.0, d: 2.2 }, // land   (G4, held + breath)
];

const ANTHEM_BEAT = 0.95; // quarter note at Maestoso ≈ 63 bpm, in seconds

let anthemGain: GainNode | null = null;
let anthemTimer: number | null = null;
let anthemRunning = false;
let anthemIndex = 0;

function anthemBell(frequency: number, at: number, beats: number) {
  const ctx = audioCtx;
  if (!ctx || !anthemGain) return;
  const dur = beats * ANTHEM_BEAT;
  const voice = ctx.createOscillator();
  voice.type = "sine";
  voice.frequency.value = frequency;
  const shimmer = ctx.createOscillator();
  shimmer.type = "sine";
  shimmer.frequency.value = frequency * 2;
  const shimmerGain = ctx.createGain();
  shimmerGain.gain.value = 0.16;
  const bell = ctx.createGain();
  // Slow dignified swell in, long decay out — a hummed choir line, not a beep.
  bell.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, at);
  bell.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(1, at + 0.28);
  bell.gain.setValueAtTime(1, at + Math.max(0.3, dur - 0.5));
  bell.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, at + dur);
  voice.connect(bell);
  shimmer.connect(shimmerGain).connect(bell);
  bell.connect(anthemGain);
  voice.start(at);
  shimmer.start(at);
  voice.stop(at + dur + 0.1);
  shimmer.stop(at + dur + 0.1);
}

function startAnthem() {
  const ctx = ensureAudioCtx();
  if (!ctx || !master || anthemRunning) return;
  anthemRunning = true;
  anthemGain ??= ctx.createGain();
  // Mixed well below the narration: the anthem colours the bed, the voice
  // always carries.
  anthemGain.gain.value = 0.3;
  anthemGain.connect(master);
  const step = () => {
    if (!anthemRunning || !audioCtx || !anthemGain) return;
    const note = ANTHEM_MELODY[anthemIndex % ANTHEM_MELODY.length];
    anthemBell(note.f, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.06, note.d);
    const gapAtPhraseEnd = anthemIndex % ANTHEM_MELODY.length === ANTHEM_MELODY.length - 1 ? 2.4 : 0.12;
    anthemTimer = window.setTimeout(
      step,
      (note.d * ANTHEM_BEAT + gapAtPhraseEnd) * 1000 - 45,
    );
    anthemIndex += 1;

}

function stopAnthem() {

 * Seed the first batch of activated chapters.
 *
 * The founder supplies these schools directly, so they are created as
 * ACTIVE chapters in the portal database and appear everywhere live data
 * is read — the chapter directory, the homepage counters, the impact page
 * and the admin dashboard.
 *
 * Safe to re-run: each chapter is keyed on its unique code, so the script
 * only creates what is missing and refreshes the activation of what is
 * already there.
 *
 * Usage: npx tsx scripts/seed-chapters.ts
 */

import "dotenv/config";
import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";

const db = new PrismaClient();

/** Institution names exactly as they appear in src/lib/institutions.ts, so
 *  the chapter list, the application forms and the factsheet never disagree. */
const SCHOOLS: Array<{
  name: string;
  institution: string;
  city: string;
  state: string;
}> = [
  {
    name: "GLANCE Club, Federal University Oye-Ekiti",
    institution: "Federal University, Oye-Ekiti",
    city: "Oye-Ekiti",
    state: "Ekiti State",
  },
  {
    name: "GLANCE Club, Lead City University",
    institution: "Lead City University, Ibadan",
    city: "Ibadan",
    state: "Oyo State",
  },
  {
    name: "GLANCE Club, Abiola Ajimobi Technical University",
    institution: "Abiola Ajimobi Technical University, Ibadan",
    city: "Ibadan",
    state: "Oyo State",
  },
  {
    name: "GLANCE Club, University of Ilorin",
    institution: "University of Ilorin, Ilorin",
    city: "Ilorin",
    state: "Kwara State",
  },
  {
    name: "GLANCE Club, University of Nigeria",
    institution: "University of Nigeria, Nsukka",
    city: "Nsukka",
    state: "Enugu State",
  },
  {
    name: "GLANCE Club, University of Ibadan",
    institution: "University of Ibadan, Ibadan",
    city: "Ibadan",
    state: "Oyo State",
  },
  {
    name: "GLANCE Club, Federal University Lokoja",
    institution: "Federal University, Lokoja",
    city: "Lokoja",
    state: "Kogi State",
  },
];

/** Same scheme as generateChapterCode in the portal: GLN-<initials>-001. */
function chapterCode(institution: string): string {
  const STOP_WORDS = new Set([
    "of",
    "the",
    "and",
    "for",
    "at",
    "in",
    "a",
    "federal",
    "university",
    "polytechnic",
    "college",
  ]);
  const initials = institution
    .replace(/[^A-Za-z\s]/g, " ")
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .filter((word) => !STOP_WORDS.has(word.toLowerCase()))
    .map((word) => word[0].toUpperCase())
    .join("")
    .slice(0, 3);
  return `GLN-${initials || "GL"}-001`;
}

async function main() {
  const admin = await db.user.findFirst({
    where: { role: "AGID_ADMIN", status: "ACTIVE" },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
    select: { id: true, email: true },
  });
  if (!admin) {
    throw new Error("No active AGID_ADMIN found — run scripts/seed.ts first.");
  }
  console.log(`Creating ${SCHOOLS.length} chapters by ${admin.email}`);

  for (const school of SCHOOLS) {
    const code = chapterCode(school.institution);
    const chapter = await db.chapter.upsert({
      where: { code },
      update: { status: "ACTIVE", activatedAt: new Date() },
      create: {
        code,
        name: school.name,
        institution: school.institution,
        city: school.city,
        state: school.state,
        status: "ACTIVE",
        activatedAt: new Date(),
        contactEmail: admin.email,
        description:
          "A GLANCE campus chapter: student leaders practising governance, civic engagement and leadership on their school's campus.",
        createdById: admin.id,
      },
    });
    console.log(`Activated: ${chapter.code} — ${chapter.institution}`);
  }

  const total = await db.chapter.count({ where: { status: "ACTIVE" } });
  console.log(`Active chapters in database: ${total}`);
}

main()
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(() => db.$disconnect());
"}}

+/**
+ * Seed the first batch of activated chapters.
+ *
+ * The founder supplies these schools directly, so they are created as
+ * ACTIVE chapters in the portal database and appear everywhere live data
+ * is read — the chapter directory, the homepage counters, the impact page
+ * and the admin dashboard.
+ *
+ * Safe to re-run: each chapter is keyed on its unique code, so the script
+ * only creates what is missing and refreshes the activation of what is
+ * already there.
+ *
+ * Usage: npx tsx scripts/seed-chapters.ts
+ */
+
+import "dotenv/config";
+import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+
+const db = new PrismaClient();
+
+/** Institution names exactly as they appear in src/lib/institutions.ts, so
+ *  the chapter list, the application forms and the factsheet never disagree.
+ *  Codes are explicit: theautomatic initials rule collapses
+ *  "University of Ilorin, Ilorin" and "University of Ibadan, Ibadan" to the
+ *  same GLN-II-001, so each school carries its own stable code. */
+const SCHOOLS: Array<{
+  code: string;
+  name: string;
+  institution: string;
+  city: string;
+  state: string;
+}> = [
+  {
+    code: "GLN-OE-001",
+    name: "GLANCE Club, Federal University Oye-Ekiti",
+    institution: "Federal University, Oye-Ekiti",
+    city: "Oye-Ekiti",
+    state: "Ekiti State",
+  },
+  {
+    code: "GLN-LCI-001",
+    name: "GLANCE Club, Lead City University",
+    institution: "Lead City University, Ibadan",
+    city: "Ibadan",
+    state: "Oyo State",
+  },
+  {
+    code: "GLN-AAT-001",
+    name: "GLANCE Club, Abiola Ajimobi Technical University",
+    institution: "Abiola Ajimobi Technical University, Ibadan",
+    city: "Ibadan",
+    state: "Oyo State",
+  },
+  {
+    code: "GLN-UNIL-001",
+    name: "GLANCE Club, University of Ilorin",
+    institution: "University of Ilorin, Ilorin",
+    city: "Ilorin",
+    state: "Kwara State",
+  },
+  {
+    code: "GLN-UNN-001",
+    name: "GLANCE Club, University of Nigeria",
+    institution: "University of Nigeria, Nsukka",
+    city: "Nsukka",
+    state: "Enugu State",
+  },
+  {
+    code: "GLN-UIB-001",
+    name: "GLANCE Club, University of Ibadan",
+    institution: "University of Ibadan, Ibadan",
+    city: "Ibadan",
+    state: "Oyo State",
+  },
+  {
+    code: "GLN-FUL-001",
+    name: "GLANCE Club, Federal University Lokoja",
+    institution: "Federal University, Lokoja",
+    city: "Lokoja",
+    state: "Kogi State",
+  },
+];
+
+
+
+async function main() {
+  // An earlier run collided the Ilorin/Ibadan initials into one GLN-II-001
+  // record; re-home it to the explicit Ilorin code before seeding.
+  const legacyIlorin = await db.chapter.findFirst({
+    where: { code: "GLN-II-001", institution: { contains: "Ilorin" } },
+    select: { id: true },
+  });
+  if (legacyIlorin) {
+    await db.chapter.update({
+      where: { id: legacyIlorin.id },
+      data: { code: "GLN-UNIL-001" },
+    });
+    console.log("Re-homed legacy GLN-II-001 to GLN-UNIL-001 (Ilorin)");
+  }
+
+  const admin = await db.user.findFirst({
+    where: { role: "AGID_ADMIN", status: "ACTIVE" },
+    orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
+    select: { id: true, email: true },
+  });
+  if (!admin) {
+    throw new Error("No active AGID_ADMIN found — run scripts/seed.ts first.");
+  }
+  console.log(`Creating ${SCHOOLS.length} chapters by ${admin.email}`);
+
+  for (const school of SCHOOLS) {
+    const code = school.code;
+    const chapter = await db.chapter.upsert({
+      where: { code },
+      update: { status: "ACTIVE", activatedAt: new Date() },
+      create: {
+        code,
+        name: school.name,
+        institution: school.institution,
+        city: school.city,
+        state: school.state,
+        status: "ACTIVE",
+        activatedAt: new Date(),
+        contactEmail: admin.email,
+        description:
+          "A GLANCE campus chapter: student leaders practising governance, civic engagement and leadership on their school's campus.",
+        createdById: admin.id,
+      },
+    });
+    console.log(`Activated: ${chapter.code} — ${chapter.institution}`);
+  }
+
+  const total = await db.chapter.count({ where: { status: "ACTIVE" } });
+  console.log(`Active chapters in database: ${total}`);
+}
+
+main()
+  .catch((error) => {
+    console.error(error);
+    process.exitCode = 1;
+  })
+  .finally(() => db.$disconnect());

import { useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";

/**
 * Click-to-load wrapper for third-party video embeds (YouTube films, Instagram
 * reels). The embed iframe does not exist until a visitor taps the poster, so
 * nothing plays — not even a muted autoplay — while they are just moving
 * around the website. The founder film on the homepage follows the same
 * pattern, and this is the gallery's version of it.
 *
 * `playSrc` is the URL loaded on activation. When it is a YouTube embed the
 * `autoplay=1` flag is expected to be part of it: the tap that mounts the
 * iframe is the visitor's own gesture, so it is legitimate — and it is the only
 * path to playback, unlike the live iframe, which played on page load.
 */
export function EmbedPlayer({
  src,
  playSrc,
  title,
  posterUrl,
  label,
}: {
  /** Embed URL shown on the resting poster (not matched until asked for). */
  src: string;
  /** Embed URL used when the visitor taps play. YouTube items pass a copy
   *  with `autoplay=1`; other providers leave it out. */
  playSrc?: string;
  title: string;
  /** Optional poster image (the YouTube film's own real opening frame). */
  posterUrl?: string;
  /** Visible label when there is no poster image to show. */
  label?: string;
}) {
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="relative aspect-video w-full overflow-hidden bg-navy-950">
      {loaded ? (
        <iframe
          src={playSrc ?? src}
          title={title}
          allow="accelerometer; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"
          allowFullScreen
          referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
          className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full"
        />
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setLoaded(true)}
          className="group absolute inset-0 text-center"
          aria-label={`Play ${title.toLowerCase()}`}
        >
          {posterUrl ? (
            <Image
              src={posterUrl}
              alt=""
              fill
              unoptimized
              sizes="(min-width: 1024px) 640px, 100vw"
              className="object-cover"
            />
          ) : null}
          <span
            aria-hidden="true"
            className={
              posterUrl
                ? "absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(120%_100%_at_30%_20%,rgba(6,20,46,0.45),rgba(3,12,28,0.82))]"
                : "absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-navy-900 via-navy-800 to-violet-900"

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";

/**
 * Edge-level first line of defence for the management portal.
 *
 * Requests without a session cookie never reach a renderer | they receive a
 * hard HTTP 307 to the login page instead of a streamed shell. The cookie
 * check here is intentionally cheap and non-authoritative: every portal page
 * and server action still validates the full session against the database in
 * src/server/auth.ts. This guard only removes an obvious anonymous path to
 * protected markup.
 */
const SESSION_COOKIE = "glance_session";

/** Unauthenticated entry points that must stay reachable. */
const PUBLIC_PORTAL_PATHS = new Set([
  "/portal/login",
  "/portal/forgot-password",
  "/portal/reset-password",
  "/portal/activate",
]);

export function proxy(request: NextRequest): NextResponse {
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;

  if (PUBLIC_PORTAL_PATHS.has(pathname)) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }

  if (!request.cookies.has(SESSION_COOKIE)) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/portal/login", request.url), 307);
  }

  return NextResponse.next();
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ["/portal/:path*"],
};

function createSdkStub({ loaded = false, optedIn = false, recording = false, throws = [] } = {}) {
  const failures = new Set(throws);
  const calls = { init: [], optIn: 0, start: 0, stop: 0, optOut: 0, startArgs: [], optInArgs: [] };
  const state = { loaded, optedIn, recording };
  const guard = (name) => {
    if (failures.has(name)) throw new Error(`stub sdk ${name} failed`);
  };

  return {
    calls,
    state,
    sdk: {
      get __loaded() {
        return state.loaded;
      },
      init(token, config) {
        guard("init");
        calls.init.push({ token, config });
        state.loaded = true;
      },
      opt_in_capturing(...args) {
        guard("optIn");
        calls.optIn += 1;
        calls.optInArgs.push(args);
        state.optedIn = true;
      },
      opt_out_capturing() {
        guard("optOut");
        calls.optOut += 1;
        state.optedIn = false;
      },
      has_opted_in_capturing() {
        guard("hasOptedIn");
        return state.optedIn;
      },
      startSessionRecording(...args) {
        guard("start");
        calls.start += 1;
        calls.startArgs.push(args);
        state.recording = true;
      },
      stopSessionRecording() {
        guard("stop");
        calls.stop += 1;
        state.recording = false;
      },
      sessionRecordingStarted() {
        guard("recording");
        return state.recording;
      },
    },
  };
}

function createConsentStub(initial = "unknown") {
  let value = initial;
  const listeners = new Set();
  return {

    set(next) {
      value = next;
      for (const listener of listeners) listener();
    },
    get listenerCount() {
      return listeners.size;

  };
}

import { useActionState, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import { Field, FormMessage, SubmitButton } from "@/components/forms/form-parts";
import { createMediaAction } from "@/server/actions/media";
import { idleFormState } from "@/server/validation";

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-white px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] text-navy-900 placeholder:text-ink-300 focus:border-navy-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-navy-500/15 focus:outline-none";

/**
 * A gallery item can come from two places: a photo uploaded straight from the
 * device (phone gallery or laptop file picker) through the same signed
 * Cloudinary pipeline the avatars use, or a pasted link (image URL, or a
 * YouTube link when the item is a film). The upload fills the same hidden
 * `url` field, so the server action keeps one path for both.
 */
export function MediaForm() {
  const [state, formAction] = useActionState(createMediaAction, idleFormState);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<"IMAGE" | "VIDEO">("IMAGE");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [localError, setLocalError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploadedPreview, setUploadedPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const urlInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const fileInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  async function upload(file: File) {
    setLocalError(null);

    if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) {
      setLocalError("Choose an image file (JPG, PNG or WebP).");
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setLocalError("That image is over 4 MB. Please choose a smaller one.");
      return;
    }

    setBusy("Uploading photo…");
    setUploadedPreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));

    try {
      const sign = await fetch("/api/cloudinary/signature", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ scope: "gallery-media" }),
      });
      if (!sign.ok) {
        const body = (await sign.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string };
        throw new Error(body.error || "Could not start the upload.");
      }

      const sig = (await sign.json()) as {
        uploadUrl: string;
        apiKey: string;
        timestamp: number;
        folder: string;
        publicId: string;
        signature: string;
      };

      const body = new FormData();
      body.append("file", file);
      body.append("api_key", sig.apiKey);
      body.append("timestamp", String(sig.timestamp));
      body.append("folder", sig.folder);
      body.append("public_id", sig.publicId);
      body.append("signature", sig.signature);

      const uploaded = await fetch(sig.uploadUrl, { method: "POST", body });
      if (!uploaded.ok) {
        throw new Error("Cloudinary rejected that image. Please try another.");
      }
      const result = (await uploaded.json()) as { secure_url?: string };
      if (!result.secure_url) throw new Error("Upload finished without an image URL.");

      // The returned delivery URL feeds the form's own `url` field, so the
      // existing server action saves it exactly like a pasted https link.
      if (urlInput.current) urlInput.current.value = result.secure_url;
      setUploadedPreview(result.secure_url);
    } catch (error) {
      setLocalError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "The upload failed.");
      setUploadedPreview(null);
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form action={formAction} className="space-y-4">
      <FormMessage state={state} />
      {state.success ? (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-emerald-700"
        >
          {state.success}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <Field label="Item type" htmlFor="kind" required>
        <select
          id="kind"
          name="kind"
          className={inputClass}
          value={kind}
          onChange={(event) => {
            const next = event.target.value === "VIDEO" ? "VIDEO" : "IMAGE";
            setKind(next);
            setLocalError(null);
            setUploadedPreview(null);
            if (urlInput.current) urlInput.current.value = "";
          }}
        >
          <option value="IMAGE">Photo</option>
          <option value="VIDEO">Video (YouTube)</option>
        </select>
      </Field>

      <Field label="Title" htmlFor="media-title" required error={state.errors?.title}>
        <input
          id="media-title"
          name="title"
          placeholder="Leading at 27, campus activation"
          className={inputClass}
          required
        />
      </Field>

      {kind === "IMAGE" ? (
        <>
          <Field
            label="Photo"
            htmlFor="media-file"
            required
            hint="Pick an image from this device — phone gallery or computer. Links still work too."
            error={localError && !uploadedPreview ? localError : state.errors?.url}
          >
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => fileInput.current?.click()}
                  disabled={busy !== null}
                  className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-lg border border-line bg-white px-4 text-[12.5px] font-bold text-navy-800 transition-colors hover:border-navy-200 hover:bg-navy-50 disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  {uploadedPreview && !busy ? "Choose another photo" : "Upload from device"}
                </button>
                {busy ? (
                  <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-navy-700">{busy}</span>
                ) : uploadedPreview ? (
                  <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                    Photo ready
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </div>
              <input
                ref={fileInput}
                id="media-file"
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                className="sr-only"
                disabled={busy !== null}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const file = event.target.files?.[0];
                  if (file) void upload(file);
                  event.target.value = "";
                }}
              />
              {uploadedPreview ? (
                <div className="h-24 w-32 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-line bg-navy-50">
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img
                    src={uploadedPreview}
                    alt="Preview of the selected photo"
                    className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                  />
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </Field>

          <Field
            label="Or paste an image link"
            htmlFor="media-url"
            hint="Only needed when you skip the upload."
            error={null}
          >
            <input
              ref={urlInput}
              id="media-url"
              name="url"
              placeholder="https://res.cloudinary.com/…"
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </Field>
        </>
      ) : (
        <Field
          label="Link"
          htmlFor="media-url"
          required
          hint="A YouTube link — the film plays inside the page."
          error={state.errors?.url ?? (localError ? undefined : undefined)}
        >
          <input
            ref={urlInput}
            id="media-url"
            name="url"
            placeholder="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…"
            className={inputClass}
            required
          />
        </Field>
      )}

      <Field label="Caption" htmlFor="media-caption" error={state.errors?.caption}>
        <textarea
          id="media-caption"
          name="caption"
          rows={3}
          placeholder="A short line shown under the item."
          className={inputClass}
        />
      </Field>

      <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-ink-600">
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          name="published"
          defaultChecked
          className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-line text-navy-900 focus:ring-navy-500"
        />
        Publish to the public gallery immediately
      </label>

      <SubmitButton
        pendingLabel={busy ?? "Saving…"}
        className="w-full"
      >
        Add to gallery
      </SubmitButton>
    </form>
  );
}
"}}

import { useActionState, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";

import { idleFormState } from "@/server/validation";

/**
 * The sign-in card's options: "Remember me" and "Forgot password?" live in
 * one small dropdown instead of a loose row, so nothing scatters across the
 * card on a phone. Escape and a click outside close it; toggling the
 * checkbox keeps the menu open so the state stays visible.
 */
function LoginOptionsDropdown() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const menuId = useId();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    function onPointerDown(event: PointerEvent) {
      if (!wrapRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    }
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        setOpen(false);
        triggerRef.current?.focus();
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <div ref={wrapRef} className="relative inline-block">
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? menuId : undefined}
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/15 bg-white/[0.06] px-3 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-semibold text-white/80 transition-colors hover:border-white/30 hover:text-white"
      >
        Sign-in options
        <svg
          className={`h-3 w-3 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`}
          viewBox="0 0 12 12"
          fill="none"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d="M2.5 4.5 6 8l3.5-3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </svg>
      </button>

      {open ? (
        <div
          id={menuId}
          role="menu"
          className="absolute right-0 bottom-full z-30 mb-1.5 w-56 origin-bottom-right overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-[#0b2038] p-1.5 shadow-[0_20px_44px_-20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]"
        >
          <label
            className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-medium text-white/85 hover:bg-white/[0.07]"
            onClick={(event) => {
              // Toggling must not close the menu — the checkbox state has to
              // stay readable right where the finger just was.
              event.stopPropagation();
            }}
          >
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              name="remember"
              defaultChecked
              className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-white/20 bg-white/10 text-gold-500 focus:ring-gold-400"
            />
            Remember me
          </label>
          <Link
            role="menuitem"
            href="/portal/forgot-password"
            className="block rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-gold-300 hover:bg-white/[0.07]"
          >
            Forgot password?
          </Link>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import Redis from "ioredis";

/**
 * Shared Redis (Upstash) client.
 *
 * Enabled only when both `REDIS_ENABLED=true` and `REDIS_URL` are present, so
 * an instance without the service falls back silently to the in-memory
 * limiters. The client is created lazily on first use and reused for the
 * process lifetime; `getRedis` awaits a connected socket (capped at 3s) so the
 * first limiter call never races the TLS handshake. Upstash's TCP endpoint
 * serves TLS even when the URL is written with a plain `redis://` scheme, so
 * the TLS option is enforced for that provider and skipped for local dev URLs.
 */
let client: Redis | null = null;
let readyPromise: Promise<Redis | null> | null = null;

export function getRedisStatus(): string {
  return client?.status ?? "not-created";
}

export async function getRedis(): Promise<Redis | null> {
  if (process.env.REDIS_ENABLED !== "true") return null;
  const url = process.env.REDIS_URL;
  if (!url) return null;

  if (readyPromise) return readyPromise;
  if (client) return client;

  try {
    const isLocal = /^(redis(s)?:\/\/)(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)/.test(url);
    const created = new Redis(url, {
      // A limiter must never stall an action on Redis latency: one retry at
      // most, then fall back to in-memory for that request.
      maxRetriesPerRequest: 1,
      enableOfflineQueue: false,
      connectTimeout: 5000,
      retryStrategy: (times) => (times > 2 ? null : Math.min(times * 200, 800)),
      ...(isLocal ? {} : { tls: {} }),
    });
    created.on("error", () => {
      // Connection-level failures degrade to the in-memory limiter; the
      // ioredis default would otherwise crash the process on a blip.
    });
    client = created;

    readyPromise = new Promise<Redis | null>((resolve) => {
      created.once("ready", () => resolve(created));
      created.once("end", () => {
        // Retry strategy gave up (e.g. network down): reset so a later call
        // can build a fresh connection instead of caching a dead client.
        if (client === created) {
          client = null;
          readyPromise = null;
        }
        created.disconnect();
        resolve(null);
      });
      // Still handshaking after 3s: hand the socket back and let the caller's
      // try/catch fall back to memory rather than blocking the request.
      setTimeout(() => resolve(created), 3000);
    });
    return readyPromise;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
